text:
aj: Quick check-in — proposing we split the large "session-mesh" service into three focused lanes for the next quarter: prefix-store, routing-core, and health-proxy. rough cut of ownership + safety nets below.

lina: TL;DR on why 3 and not 2?

aj: Two reasons — isolation for hotpath KV (prefix-store) to tune batching/kv-cache without affecting routing logic; and a thin health-proxy so we can rollback health checks independently.

sohail: Sounds reasonable. Concern: cross-service latency for short-lived requests. Have we measured serialization overhead if we RPC between them?

morgan: We have some traces. A simple protobuf RPC adds ~0.7ms median when co-located on same AZ. If we co-locate and enable fast-path shared memory for bursts, it can be <0.2ms.

aj: Plan is co-location by default for Dedicated hosts, collocation hints for hosted. Also will expose a local in-memory shim for same-pod calls to keep latency low.

lina: Rollout plan? We need a safe cutover; past refactors broke retries.

aj: Proposal: green-release on canary tenant set (10%), with traffic shadowing from routing-core to prefix-store. Stepwise cutover: 1) extract libs -> 2) deploy read-only prefix-store + shadow write -> 3) enable writes behind feature flag + monitor -> 4) promote.

sohail: Add a rollback kill switch at the edge that routes traffic back to monolith on SIG. Also add synthetic checks for cache warm-up.

morgan: I added a small snippet to the runbook for cache warm-up:
```
# warmup script outline
for p in $(cat hot_prefixes.txt); do 
  curl -sS -X POST http://prefix-store.local/warmup -d "\$p" || true
done
```
Include as pre-promote step.

infra-bot: deploy-candidate: prefix-store-v1 built (sha: a1b2c3). integration tests queued.

lina: Observability — what dashboards/alerts?

aj: surface per-route p95, cache hit ratio, cross-service tail (99.9th) and error budget burn. Also a regression alert if end-to-end p99 increases by >10% vs baseline.

sohail: We should also add a rollout SLA gate — if any canary sees >=1s tail or 5xx spike for 5m, auto-fallback to monolith.

morgan: Noted. I'll add the gate to the orchestration template.

aj: Ownership: routing-core -> platform-team, prefix-store -> infra-storage, health-proxy -> runtime-safety. I'll sync with leads after this thread.

lina: Thanks. One more ask: doc the compatibility contract (proto + header expectations). small PR please.

aj: Will open RFC follow-up PR today with interface sketch and churn estimator.

sohail: If we do shared-memory shim, record fallback path clearly — operators need to know how to force RPC-only mode for debugging.

morgan: Will include.

infra-bot: integration-tests: prefix-store-v1 passed (14/14).

aj: Cool — next step: RFC follow-up + runbook PR. tagging @lina @sohail @morgan for review.

lina: I'll review the PR tomorrow. :thumbsup:

sohail: Same.

morgan: adding checklist items to sprint board.

aj: End of thread.
